criticalPath.title: Release v0.2.0 so the registry Action (which installs a release) can be tested end to end

risks: Docs must continue to avoid implying that Hikma AI itself is a canonical skill registry; it is the CLI that works with user-configured registries.
The macOS cask prints a Homebrew deprecation warning and the binary is not notarized.
skill push is proven on a real repo with write access (branch, PR, add commit, fresh branch after merge); the fork path for users without write access is still only covered by the fake GitHub.
The registry Action installs a release, so it cannot be tested end to end until a release contains --format github (v0.2.0).
